notes.title: 12-19 Update English language pack
notes.notes: The game now supports English, which can be switched through the "Settings" in the game.

notes.title: 8.10 Update
notes.notes:
The game setting function now allows modifying the default resolution.
Currently supported resolutions:
3840*2160
2560*1440
1920*1080
1600*900
1440*800
1334*750
1280*720
1024*576

notes.title: Update on August 3, 2023
notes.notes:
1.Added cup protection, preventing players from dropping below the highest rank achieved in the current season by -3 or more ranks.
2.Fixed a bug that deducted the alliance member's highest contribution record erroneously.
3.Fixed issues where certain skill effects were not displayed correctly and had mismatched sound effects.
4.Fixed instances where the congratulatory window didn't appear when the lord leveled up.
5.Added the ability to flip pages by clicking the arrows in exciting events.
6.Changed the cost of class transfer from 500 ingots to 10,000 copper coins.
7.Added the ability to directly open relevant functions with transfer tokens and name change tokens.
8.Added reminders and displays in the deck when non-native profession skill cards are present.
9.Optimized the process of impeaching the alliance leader and the voting mechanism.
10.Optimized certain UI displays and resolved overlapping issues.
11.Improved symbol clarity in certain text explanations.
